note: The change skills as they are today, one line each, from each SKILL.md description. The change workflow is being redesigned, so the book lists them and says no more.

change.name: requirement-update-workflow
change.what: The workflow for a change. It takes one change to your decision, and writes it into a Change impact report. The workflows its recommendation names then apply the change.

change.name: change-impact-author
change.what: Writes the analysis of one change in its Change impact report: where it lands, its kind, what is linked and how big it is. It holds the gate "Accept the recommendation, including the size?".

change.name: adversarial-check
change.what: Challenges the verdict in a Change impact report, and reports only what is wrong with it. Run by `change-impact-author`.

change.name: feature-impact
change.what: Judges whether one item made from a requirement is hit by a change, how badly, and what to do about it. Run by `change-impact-author`, once for each linked item.
